description: Create a valid e-invoice from structured data: XRechnung 3.0 (UBL or CII), ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (EN 16931) or Peppol BIS Billing 3.0. The file is checked with the official KoSIT validator before it is returned; if it fails, you get the rule errors instead of a file. XML comes back as text in `xml`, the ZUGFeRD PDF as base64 in `pdf_base64`. XRechnung needs a seller contact (contact, phone, email), a buyer email or Peppol ID (electronic address), a buyer_reference (Leitweg-ID for German authorities) and payment details (iban). Peppol needs peppol_id for seller and buyer.

delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD delivery / service date (BT-72); default: issue date unless a period is given

exempt_reason.description: BT-120 text for VAT-exempt (E) lines; default for DE/FR small businesses without VAT ID: § 19 UStG / art. 293 B CGI

preceding_invoice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, date of the original invoice (BT-26; required for French sellers)

tax_number.description: Tax number (BT-32) if the seller has no VAT ID: German Steuernummer (Kleinunternehmer), French SIREN (franchise en base)

skonto_base.description: Optional base amount if Skonto applies to part of the amount due

skonto_days.description: Early-payment discount (Skonto): days; written into BT-20 in the XRechnung format (BR-DE-18)

name: create_einvoice
title: Create an e-invoice
